CITY  OF  ALHAMBRA

  NOTICE OF SPECIAL MEETING
  OF THE
  ALHAMBRA CIVIL SERVICE COMMISSION
  (Notice No. N2M25-70)

NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that a special meeting of the Alhambra Civil Service Commission
will be held on Tuesday, June 10, 2025, commencing at 6:00 p.m. in the City Council
Chambers of the Alhambra City Hall, 111 South First Street, Alhambra, California pursuant
to Section 54956 of the Government Code of the State of California.

An agenda of such special meeting is attached hereto incorporated herein by reference and made
a part hereof as though fully set forth herein.

  MARIAM LEE KO
  Director of Human Resources & Risk Management
  Ex-Officio Member, Civil Service Commission

Dated:  June 2, 2025
Notice No.  N2M25-70
   CITY OF ALHAMBRA
  AGENDA
  ALHAMBRA CIVIL SERVICE COMMISSION
  SPECIAL MEETING
  June 10, 2025 at 6:00 PM

  Alhambra City Hall
  City Council Chambers – 2nd Floor of City Hall
  111 South First Street
  Alhambra, CA 91801

In compliance with the Americans with Disability Act, if you need special assistance to participate in this
meeting, please contact Raquel Herrera, Human Resources Manager (626) 570-5095. Notification 48
hours prior to the meeting will enable the City to make reasonable arrangements to ensure accessibility to
this meeting. (28 CFR 35. 102-35.104 ADA Title II). All public records relating to an agenda item on this
agenda are available for the public inspection at the time the records are distributed to all, or a majority of
all, members of the Civil Service Commission. Such records shall be available at City Hall located at 111
South First Street.

ROLL CALL:  HATEM, KAN, LIEBERG, PLASCENCIA, TELLEZ-GAGLIANO

  I.  CALL TO ORDER

  II. CLOSED SESSION:

  A. PUBLIC EMPLOYEE DISCIPLINE/DISMISSAL/RELEASE

  III. ADJOURNMENT
